players.product: Microchannel liquid cold plates, liquid-cooling modules and high-performance thermal interface materials (graphene pads, liquid metal) for AI servers, plus vapor chambers, heat pipes and air-cooling modules

quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: its self-developed vertically oriented graphene thermal pad has completed R&D and now has initial mass-production capability; aimed at the thermal management of GPU, ASIC and other high-power chips in AI servers, switches and high-speed optical modules, it is still in performance optimisation, reliability validation and customer sample testing, and the mass-production schedule will depend on customer validation results and market demand.

players.product: VC (vapor chamber) thermal modules, thermal interface materials and liquid-cooling modules for 800G / 1.6T optical modules (connector liquid cold plates, NPO liquid cooling)

quarterly_data.signal: Strategic stake by Innolight (the company on SZSE Interactive Easy): the company and Innolight sit upstream and downstream of each other in the optical communication industry chain, and the company says this strategic share investment will help deepen their technical cooperation and solution development in high-speed optical-module thermal management; it will keep developing, validating with customers and applying high-performance TIM, integrated VC and liquid-cooling solutions for 1.6T and next-generation optical modules and NPO / CPO architectures. The answer states no stake size and no supply order.
